title: A note on the multiple zeta functions and their variants at identical arguments
summary: In this article, we study the multiple zeta functions (MZF) and some of its variants at identical arguments. Using the harmonic product, these functions can be expressed as polynomials in the Riemann zeta function. Firstly, we note that an explicit description of the coefficients of these polynomials can be given in terms of the values of the complete Bell polynomials. This for instance, easily leads to the complete description of the singularities of these functions.
